date_range.end_date_rationale: latest complete UTC day before run date 2026-08-24; avoids partial current-day information

snapshot.timing_semantics: ranked top-500 as of end of UTC day t (lastUpdated tT23:59:00Z); normalized observation timestamp = end-of-day UTC t

raw_persistence.meta_sidecars: probes/raw/cmc_snapshot_YYYYMMDD_top500.meta.json (committed; contains sha256, http_status, retrieved_at, url, request_params, error)

failure_handling.retry: up to 6 attempts, exponential backoff 2^n + jitter
failure_handling.429_adaptive: on 429 double sleep up to 8s for subsequent requests
failure_handling.failed_dates: recorded in checkpoint with error; surfaced in quality report; FAIL date never silently skipped

post_conditions.any_date_missing_rows: REQUIRES explicit documented exception (CMC_side_data_gap_YYYYMMDD) with missing ranks recorded, or re-collection
post_conditions.hash_all_raw_inputs: sha256 per date in meta sidecar + manifest

gap_policy.reconstruction: narrow-window pagination (limit 50, start 1..451) merged by rank
gap_policy.persist: truncated body + meta sidecar preserved; recorded in checkpoint gaps
gap_policy.panel_inclusion: dates with <500 rows EXCLUDED from the panel; exclusion documented in data quality report (observed: CMC-side missing ranks, e.g. 2021-09-28 = 318 rows / 182 missing ranks)

known_limitations: internal web endpoint; NOT official documented API; TOS review required for long-term operation
rank panel is top-500 only; assets ranked >500 on a given day are absent that day
provider-internal rank/mcap monotonicity is imperfect (Spearman 0.88-0.99 observed in DATA-0); rank field is authoritative, mcap order may differ slightly
